horizons.preKickoff: Evidence publication upper bound or exact timestamp must be strictly earlier than kickoff.
horizons.advance48h: Evidence publication upper bound or exact timestamp must be at least 48 hours before kickoff.

sourcePolicy.originalTimestampVerified: Dated UEFA editorial page; date is conservatively bounded at 23:59:59 UTC and fetched text must contain both teams and referee.
sourcePolicy.indirectPreKickoff: Timestamped third-party appointment archive; exact Blogger published and last-updated timestamps must both precede kickoff, and both teams and referee must match within 14 days before kickoff.
sourcePolicy.notVerifiable: Current acquisition timestamps, undated match pages and post-match records are inadmissible.
